summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K announcing that its Class A ordinary shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange will be included in the Shanghai-Hong Kong Stock Connect program effective September 7, 2026. This follows a notice from the Shanghai Stock Exchange. The action expands access for Chinese Mainland investors and aims to diversify the investor base and enhance liquidity. No specific terms, board advisors, or structural details are provided. This is a routine market access announcement, not a special situation transaction; watch for potential increased trading volume and investor base changes.
